observations.note: Three overlapping greps for 'outbox' (the last with a broad 'hold' alternative returning about 10k characters) could have been one scoped search over docs/ and engine/src.

conformance.item: Procedure: read the triage row and the documents it names
Procedure: read the code the gap concerns, searching names first
Procedure: use the web only for a cited research source
Limits: read only, no file written, no command run, inside the working directory
Hand over: gap_finding as one line of at most 1,500 characters naming files and line ranges, ending with the ARTIFACT line
If blocked: end with a BLOCKED line
